content.short: Backed Finance tokenizes real-world assets like stocks and ETFs, bringing traditional finance to the blockchain.
content.description:
Backed Finance is a Real World Asset (RWA) tokenization platform that issues "bTokens"—ERC-20 tokens representing ownership of traditional financial assets. These assets include popular stocks like Tesla and Google, as well as exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and U.S. Treasury bonds. For every token minted, Backed purchases the underlying asset on a 1-to-1 basis and holds it with a regulated custodian, ensuring each token is fully collateralized by the actual financial instrument.

By bringing these assets on-chain, Backed Finance allows crypto users to gain exposure to traditional markets and utilize tokenized equities as collateral in DeFi protocols. This bridge between traditional and decentralized finance enhances capital efficiency and provides a broader range of investment options for blockchain participants. Backed is committed to providing a secure and transparent infrastructure for the growing RWA sector in the Web3 ecosystem.
